title: FinTrust: Stateful Reliability Governance for Forecast Ensembles in Trading (code and experiments)
description:
Governance core and experiment code for the FinTrust paper. FinTrust sits between several probabilistic forecasters and a trading decision: it scores each forecaster on matured outcomes, moves it through an explicit lifecycle (shadow, active, probation, quarantine) and records every decision in a hash-chained audit log.

The release regenerates every table and figure of the paper from saved model outputs (FI-2010, Bitstamp BTC/USD and NSE daily forecasts), and the forecasts themselves from public data. Raw market data are not redistributed; download scripts are included. No trading-profit claim is made.
